notes.title: MANIKA V1.1 Hotfix 9 is now out!
notes.content:
This update brings you these changes:

-Complete artwork rework.
-Minor bug fixes.

Known issues:

-After "You Are Dead" screen, sound and animation glitches out until loading last save.
-End of the game credits sometimes skips and directly loads main menu.

Turkish and English language localization is still on progress. Expected in MANIKA V1.2.
